meta.name: manage-mounts
meta.description: Configure which host directories agent containers can access. View, add, or remove mount allowlist entries. Triggers on "mounts", "mount allowlist", "agent access to directories", "container mounts".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理容器可访问的主机目录挂载
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要控制 agent 容器能访问哪些主机目录
copy.tagline_en: Manage which host directories agent containers can access
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control which host directories agent containers can access

howto.what: 管理 NanoClaw 代理容器能访问的主机目录：显示当前允许的目录及其读写权限，添加或删除目录，或清空列表。
howto.when: 当你说到 “mounts”、“mount allowlist”、“container mounts” 等关键词，或要求查看/添加/删除代理容器的目录访问时触发。

say.text: 显示当前的挂载允许列表
say.note: 它会展示允许的目录及读写权限。
它会验证路径并写入配置。
它会更新列表，新容器生效。

howto.what_en: Manage which host directories NanoClaw agent containers can access. Show the current allowlist with read-only/read-write flags, add or remove directories, or reset to empty.
howto.when_en: Triggers on 'mounts', 'mount allowlist', 'container mounts', or when the user asks to view/add/remove agent directory access.

say_en.note: It displays allowed directories and permissions.
It validates the path and writes config.
It updates the list for new containers.
